create_sun397_disk_filelist_dataset: create SUN397 dataset partitions (train, val, test, trainval) from input path and save as numpy files
download_sun397_dataset: download and extract the SUN397 dataset archive from Princeton vision lab into the specified root folder
split_sample_list: split a list of samples into train (70%), val (10%), test (20%), and trainval partitions with random shuffling
get_argument_parser: get an argparse parser with input, output, download, and seed arguments for the SUN397 data creation script
run_sun397_data_creation: run the SUN397 data creation script with input path, output path, download flag, and random seed
